name: Zimbabwe

flag.description: Seven horizontal stripes of green, yellow, red, black, red, yellow and green, with a white triangle edged in black at the hoist containing a yellow Zimbabwe Bird on a red star.
flag.symbolism: Green represents agriculture, yellow minerals, red the blood of the liberation struggle and black the majority people; white stands for peace, and the bird is the national emblem.

hook: Zimbabwe's white hoist triangle holds the soapstone Zimbabwe Bird beside seven mirrored stripes of green, yellow, red and black.
trivia: The Zimbabwe Bird is based on soapstone carvings found at the ruins of Great Zimbabwe.
The name Zimbabwe comes from the Shona for 'houses of stone', after those ruins.
